Methods

The ÄKTA chromatography run was executed using an automated workflow comprising manual sample loading followed by an ÄKTA Pure protocol run. The workflow consisted of the following main steps:

  1. Manual Preparation
    • Utility pause step prompted the operator to manually fill the sample loop according to the experimental plan ("Manually fill sample loop").
    • After confirmation, the automated workflow resumed.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Chromatography Run
    • The predefined ÄKTA method was started via the automation interface ("Run Protocol").
    • During the run, the following sample signals were recorded at the system sampling interval:
      • UV signal (uv1)
      • Conductivity (cond)
    • Sample data were acquired with a sampling time of 1 second throughout the run.
Run Parameters
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated ÄKTA run process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Duration of column equilibration before loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during equilibration.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Total duration of the sample loading/injection step.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during sample loading/injection.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total time of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient Start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting value of the gradient (e.g. %B at gradient start).
Elution Gradient End [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final value of the gradient (e.g. %B at gradient end).
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of the post-elution wash step.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during the wash step.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of the column cleaning-in-place (CIP) step.
CIP Step 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP segment.
CIP Step 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP segment.
CIP Step 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP segment.
CIP Step 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP segment.
